rule: every row names a runnable checker or test and a planted mutant; a row without a passing checker cannot be PROVED; no novelty claim

obligations.statement: Knowledge provenance: 'source asserts P' (IMPORTED, source=1), 'P parsed' (digest) and 'P verified' (separate evidence, verified=1) are distinct records; the fact warrant is ⊕ assertions ⊗ verification; repetition of assertions never raises authority; revoking one source kills exactly the facts it alone supported.
obligations.limitation: hand-authored manifest; Simple Wikipedia text ingestion is custody-only

obligations.statement: Realisation is a codec: every candidate surface is re-interpreted and kept only if its canonical digest equals the intended meaning; style (passive preference, contractions, certified pronouns) selects among checked variants and never changes meaning; a paraphrase that drops negation fails the reverse reading.

ResponsePlan.v1 sits above realisation; content is selected only from live world facts and speaker commitments; unverified claims carry REPORTED, unknowns REPORT_UNKNOWN, contradictions REPORT_UNCERTAIN; a missing intermediate premise in an explanation is a feedback event naming the gap; the planner cannot mint a premise (the mutant does).
obligations.limitation: registered question forms and rhetorical relations

obligations.statement: Every committed response passes the M4 gate; an unverified source claim or a speaker commitment cannot be rendered ASSERTED (MARKER_MISMATCH); the diagnostic trace is assembled from the runtime's actual ledger events and the plan/gate objects of the turn.
obligations.checker: tests/m6/test_chat_alpha.py (trace ties to ledger events and warrant ids)
obligations.limitation: trace fields are those emitted; no separate explanation model exists

obligations.statement: Learning in chat persists across process restart: learned senses/constructions are stored keyed on their ledger evidence and restored; the world index is checked against the ledger (missing evidence ⇒ CANNOT_CHECK); revoking a lesson's evidence stops the capability, reinstating restores it, unrelated knowledge intact.
obligations.mutant: (ghost evidence on restart — tested in M4)

obligations.statement: Protected scenario suite (nine families) and hostile probes: 42/42 expected replies; incidents answer_laundering 0, revoked_asserted_live 0, assertion_became_belief 0, restart_lost_state 0; external IO 0.
Blinded human evaluation (frozen protocol, report §4), matched comparators, Simple Wikipedia / Wikidata text ingestion, real protected conversations — M7 / follow-ups.
